sentences.text: BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE G. S. AHLUWALIA  ON THE 8 th OF MAY, 2025  MISC. APPEAL No. 3781 of 2025  M/S BHADAURIA AUTOMOBILE OFFICE A 87 GARG COMPLEX TP
Shri Ram Kishor Sharma - Advocate for appellant.

ORDER Office has made an objection with regard to maintainability of Miscellaneous Appeal because the total amount of compensation awarded by the trial Court is less than Rs.1,00,000/-.
2.

It is submitted by counsel for appellant that in view of Section 173 (2) of Motor Vehicles Act,
appeal is not maintainable and therefore, either he may be granted a week's time to move an application for conversion of this Miscellaneous Appeal into a Civil Revision under Section 115 of CPC or his verbal prayer may be accepted.

3. Considered the submissions made by counsel for appellant.
4.

Since the submission has been made in the light of Section 173 (2) of the Motor Vehicles Act,
therefore, verbal prayer of conversion of Miscellaneous Appeal into Civil Revision is allowed.

5. Accordingly, office is directed to register this miscellaneous appeal in the category of Civil Revision under Section 115 of CPC and list the said NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:10203 2 MA-3781-2025 case for further proceedings.
6. With aforesaid observation, this miscellaneous appeal is finally disposed of.
